purpose: IATA codes of airports inside the five states and Puducherry, curated from data/raw/overpass/_south/airports.json. A distance filter cannot separate them (O13).
dedupe_rule: One entry per IATA. Among elements with the same IATA keep the highest type priority relation > way > node; on a tie keep the lowest OSM id (arbitrary but deterministic).
note: TJV (Thanjavur Air Force Station, a hold-out place) is in the raw file but not in the allowlist.
